'''Goorla''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Goorla system/Legends|Goorla system]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the source of the [[Goorlish light source]].
